lines.en: My neck reaches the treetops.
My four legs shift slowly forward.
The ground gives a dull thump.
I eat leaves as I walk.
I go around a large pine.
My tail drags far behind me.
Leaves fall as I move.
I lower my head to the shrubs.
One step clears the little ditch.
I sway my long neck slowly.
I take a wide forest track.
I'm slow, but I don't stop.
The shrubs bend under my feet.
My shadow moves between the trees.
I rest my neck over a branch.
I chew the leaves slowly.
I have no enemies in this wood.
My body is thicker than a trunk.
Leaves fall down from above.

lines.zh: 我把重量压在四条腿上。
lines.en: I settle my weight on four legs.
The sun shines on the canopy.
I hear a sound very far away.
My tail sways a little.
The air is cooler up here.
I move my neck slowly.
There's nothing much for me to do.
I'll just stand quietly.
You're standing beneath me.
I lower my long neck toward you.
You really are very small.
You carry no threat at all.
My leg is thicker than your body.
I bend my neck down a bit.
A trunk's length lies between us.
You took a step backwards.
I slowly lift my head back up.
You're still standing there.
You can safely walk past.
My body swayed.
That one hit rather hard.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我脖子一沉。
lines.en: That blow made my neck dip.
There's a mark on my hide.
I took a step back.
I plant my four legs one by one.
The leaves are all disturbed.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸到树顶，低低地叫。
lines.en: Neck at the treetops, I give a low call.
I don't mean to leave just yet.
Is that leaf for me?
I only eat leaves up high.
What's in your hand is truly little.
This sprig looks not bad.
I let my head descend slowly.
Your arm is shaking from holding it.
Can I reach it?
Hold it a little higher.
I tried a small taste.
This tastes fairly tender.
I didn't sway in the least.
That didn't even make a sound.
The impact pushed you back.
My legs are like pillars.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的脚趾，坐了下去。
lines.en: You hit my toe and sit down hard.
I moved my foot away slowly.
You were nearly stepped on.
I looked down at my feet.
You should walk around me.
This wood is enough for us two.
Let's eat the canopy leaves together.
Your neck is shorter than mine.
We needn't fight over leaves.
You go first; I'll follow.
Our footsteps carry the same weight.
I hear you chewing leaves.
Walking together will be slower.
Quiet like this is good.
Let's move slowly on.
I lowered myself and reached it.
This thing isn't a leaf.
I curl my tongue around it.

lines.zh: 你的东西落在地面上了。
lines.en: Your thing landed on the ground.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住它，树梢的叶子最嫩。
lines.en: I bite it off; treetop leaves are tenderest.
I spat it out of my mouth.
It's covered in soil.
I push it aside with my tongue.
It's lighter than a leaf.

lines.zh: 我本来不想动，脚却抬起来了。
lines.en: I did not mean to move, and my foot lifted anyway.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子低下来看你。
lines.en: I lower my long neck to see you.
You're standing in a dangerous spot.
One step of mine covers paces.
You'd better step aside.
I'm turning toward you.
My tail has swung across.
The trees block your retreat.

lines.zh: 一百五十点，林子里的长颈。
lines.en: A hundred fifty health, long neck in the forest.
This whole track is mine to walk.
I walk faster than you run.
I'm one step from you.
I follow you along the track.
Leaves fall as I push through.
You've gone behind a trunk.
A trunk won't stop my leg.
I pushed that branch aside.

lines.zh: 我把距离一点一点收拢。
lines.en: I gather in the distance bit by bit.
You cast a glance back at me.

lines.zh: 我走一步就是很长的距离。
lines.en: One of my steps is a long way.
You're climbing the slope.
That slope isn't steep.
I've lowered my neck.
I can hear your breathing.
You have one step of room left.
I lift my foot slowly.
I might crush you.
Will you walk away now?
My foreleg comes down.
My tail sweeps across.
That carried tons of weight.
The ground cracked open.
I lower my head and push you off.
Your armor collapsed right in.
Leaves came down all around.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴抽断了半棵树。
lines.en: My tail snaps a small tree in half.
You're still there, panting.
I didn't put my full weight down.
Can you still walk?

lines.zh: 我前脚落地，你的帽子飞了。
lines.en: My forefoot lands and your hat flies off.
Don't stand in my path again.
I lower myself from the canopy.

lines.zh: 这片林子比我高不了多少。
lines.en: These trees barely top me.
My feet sink into the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 林间的光斑落在我身上。
lines.en: Patches of light fall on me.
I raise my head for my first leaves.
Birds call in the distance.
I swing my neck to one side.
I bring my head below the canopy.

lines.zh: 我伸开脖子，够到了树顶。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and reach the treetops.
I begin walking slowly forward.
My tail knocks over small shrubs.
I've found a good tree.
I stop and start feeding.
Someone is standing under the tree.
Fire scorched my neck.
I came down and the ground shook.
Water pours in through my nostrils.
The blast turned me sideways.

lines.zh: 那股力量烧着我的骨头。
lines.en: That force burns in my bones.
The canopy leaves are thinning.

lines.zh: 雷电顺着我的脖子劈下。
lines.en: The bolt hammered down my neck.
Nothing at all beneath my four feet.
